text: Hort-Ledd's Robe is a unique robe that is enchanted with the power to demoralize undead creatures and increase the wearer's armor rating.
House Cousin's Cowl is a piece of medium armor rewarded for completing the quest "Shattering Mirror." It is part of the Shadow of the Red Mountain item set.
Homespun Shoes is a pair of light armor boots in . It is made from the material Jute, which is salvaged from Raw Jute.
Homespun Jerkin is a piece of Light Armor apparel found in . Female version demonstrated in the image.
Homespun Breeches is a pair of light armor leggings found in .
The Holy Dagger is an item in . Despite its name, it is not a weapon, but only a miscellaneous item and has no purpose apart from selling.

Horulia Agrudilius is an Imperial fighter residing outside the Canton of St. Olms the Just in Vivec City, talking to Gwinadras. She initially does not appear in the city, only appearing after certain quest events have been completed. However, she has no unique dialogue.
Horse Armor Pack (DLC1) is the first official plug-in for from Bethesda. It was released for both the PC and the Xbox 360 on April 3, 2006.
Homespun Armor is a type of Light Armor in . It is the first type of light armor available to craft in the Clothing skill line. The Homespun Armor is the appropriate armor for levels 1-15.
The Honed Ancient Nord Greatsword of Scorching is a two-handed weapon in . It is a unique variant of the Honed Ancient Nord Greatsword.

Honed Ancient Nord Mace is a one-handed weapon in / that is a part of the Creation Club addon Fishing. It is visually identical to the Ancient Nord Mace, but with a higher base damage and higher weight.

Honed Ancient Nord Warhammer is a two-handed weapon in / that is a part of the Creation Club addon Fishing. It visually identical to the Ancient Nord Warhammer, but with a higher base damage and higher weight.

The Honed Ancient Nord Dagger is a one-handed weapon in / that is a part of the Creation Club addon Fishing. It is visually identical to the Ancient Nord Dagger, but with a higher base damage and higher weight.

The Hrormir's Icestaff is a unique staff found in the Arcane University, headquarters of the Mages Guild. There is only one staff like this. This staff is also unique because it has a white icy skin versus the standard wood skin that most staves have.
The Huntsman's Prowess weapon enchant that can be found on Poacher's Axe. This enchantment provides a damage bonus against animals, but it does not provide a glow effect to the enchanted weapon.
Hrolfdir's Shield is a unique Steel Shield and quest item found in .
Ice Armor, also known as Stalhrim Armor, is a type of Medium Armor found in via the expansion .
Hrothmund's Barrow is a location in . It is the burial ground of Hrothmund the Red. He was killed by the wolf, Ondjage, who inhabits the barrow. Hrothmund's Axe can be found here.
The Ice Armor Boots are a piece of medium armor and part of the ice armor set in .
Ice Armor Helmet is a piece of medium armor and part of the Ice Armor armor set.
Ice Armor Left Pauldron is an piece of medium armor and part of the ice armor set in .

Hrothmund's Axe is the legendary battle-axe once wielded by Hrothmund the Red. Hrothmund used the axe to slay Drengr Bronze-Helm, thus making him Chieftain of the Thirsk Mead Hall. The axe is lodged into a stone within Hrothmund's resting place, Hrothmund's Barrow. Though seen by both the Nerevarine and Dragonborn, neither can equip and utilize the weapon.

Hrothmund's Blessing is an Alteration and Illusion spell in that surrounds the Nerevarine with a shield of elemental frost, providing resistance to Frost Damage, and damaging nearby adversaries for 10% of the effect's magnitude. It also increases the Nerevarine's chance of evading physical attacks. This includes hand-to-hand combat and melee or ranged weapons, but has no affect on magic.

Huntsman Longsword is an unenchanted one-handed weapon in . There are two of these long blades available in Solstheim. One is possessed by Hroldar the Strange when he is at Fort Frostmoth. The other blade is found in a small alcove in the southeastern Varstaad Caves, near a skeleton and chest.
Hyamir is an Altmer noble in who works for the First Auridon Marines as a weapon and armor supplier. He is currently found in Mathiisen on orders of High Kinlord Rilis XIII.
Hunding's Rage is an crafted item set in . The Vestige must have researched any six traits in the type of armor, weapon or jewelry that they wish to craft in the Hunding's Rage set.
The Hylian Shield is a shield in The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition that is exclusive to the Nintendo Switch platform.

Ice Blade of the Monarch is a two-handed claymore and an artifact created by Archmage Almion Celmo for a failed assassination attempt that has since fell into the hands of a series of malefactors. It is enchanted to inflict Frost Damage, and is currently in the possession of Llaren Terano, a Sorcerer who can be found in the Dunmer stronghold of Rotheran on the island of Sheogorad, south of Dagon Fel.

Imperial Armor is a set of heavy armor that appears in . Imperial armor is primarily worn by Legates in the Imperial Legion. Despite being made primarily of steel, it is one of the weakest types of heavy armor available, on par with iron armor. Unlike other sets, it comes with three variants of helmet — the craftable Imperial Helmet, Imperial Officer's Helmet and the Closed Imperial Helmet.
Ilfhild is a Nord battlemage who resides at the smuggling ship Grytewake.
Icy Spear is an Expert-level Destruction spell in . Icy Spear can be considered an upgraded version of Ice Spike as it behaves similarly but with higher damage.

The Illusion Staff is a staff which appears in . They are found as randomized loot in containers and on leveled mage-based enemies. Each staff is outfitted with a random enchantment falling under the Illusion school of Magicka.
Illkurok is a unique item spear that can be found in the Dwemer Ruins of Nchurdamz.
The Illusory War Axe is a non-obtainable axe sharing its appearance with the ancient Nord war axe. The two are identical, except the former has a damage value of 1.
Ifuss is a Nord patron of the Ship's Hold Inn in Alten Corimont.
Imperial Axe Skill is a Restoration spell in that temporarily increases the value of axe. The skill returns to its original value when the spell ends.
Imperial Blunt Weapon Skill is a Restoration spell in that temporarily increases the value of blunt weapons. The skill returns to its original value when the spell ends.
Immortal Warrior is an item set in . Pieces are Heavy Armor in the Celestial Style, and can be obtained in Sanctum Ophidia. Items in this set are called Immortal Yokeda.
Ice Scouts are an Ice Tribe enemy variant in . They appear as blue-skinned men with a helmet, cuirass, and pauldron. In combat they can inflict the player with a status ailment called Frost Limbs.

Ice Staves are a type of weapon in . Ice staves deal spell damage and take up both weapon slots to wield. Destruction Staff abilities can be used with destruction staves and Destruction Staff passive skills affect their use in combat.

The Ice Staff of the Lunar Bastion is a ice staff in obtained from the Maw of Lorkhaj trial. The Ice Staff may be dropped by bosses or obtained from the Dro-m'Athra's Burnished Coffer or Dro-m'Athra's Shining Coffer during the course of the quest "Into the Maw." The Ice Staff is a part of the Lunar Bastion item set.

The Ice Staff of Alkosh is a ice staff in obtained from the Maw of Lorkhaj trial. The Ice Staff may be dropped by bosses or obtained from the Dro-m'Athra's Burnished Coffer or Dro-m'Athra's Shining Coffer during the course of the quest "Into the Maw." The Ice Staff is a part of the Roar of Alkosh item set.

The Ice Staff of Twilight Remedy is a ice staff in obtained from the Maw of Lorkhaj trial. The Ice Staff may be dropped by bosses or obtained from the Dro-m'Athra's Burnished Coffer or Dro-m'Athra's Shining Coffer during the course of the quest "Into the Maw." The Ice Staff is a part of the Twilight Remedy item set.
Icy Conjuror is a dungeon set in . It is a Light Armor Coldsnap Style set, and can be found in Frostvault.
If I had a Hammer is a quest in that is a part of the Stendarr's Hammer Creation Club content.
Imitation Netch Leather is a miscellaneous item in that is a part of the Netch Leather Armor Creation Club content.
The Imperial Sword is a one-handed weapon found in . It serves as the primary melee weapon used by the Imperial Legion in Skyrim.
Imperial Watch Armor is a type of armor in . It is worn by the Watch Captains, as well as the elite Palace Guards that oversee the protection of the Imperial City Palace and the Elder Council.

Imperial Dragon Armor or Emperor's Armor, is a set of armor worn only by the emperors of the Tamrielic Empire. It was presumably first worn by Tiber Septim, and thus became a tradition for the emperors following him. Martin Septim wears a set during the Defense of Bruma quest. The Hero of Kvatch was allowed to wear Imperial Dragon Armor in a change of tradition by Chancellor Ocato, head of the Elder Council.
The Imperial Bow is an archery weapon that serves as the primary ranged weapon used by the Imperial Legion in .

Imperial Light Armor is a set of light armor worn by the vast majority of the Imperial Legion. It is one of the earliest forms of armor available to the Dragonborn, given by Hadvar if he is followed, and lootable from the corpses Imperial soldiers at Helgen during the quest "Unbound."
Imperial Palace is the tenth and final main quest of . In this quest, the Champion uses the Staff of Chaos to defeat Jagar Tharn and free Emperor Uriel Septim VII.

The Imperial Officer's Helmet is a semi-rare piece of heavy armor and part of the Imperial Armor set found in . It is more protective than the Imperial Helmet, but is typically only worn by captains and legates of the Imperial Legion.
The Imperial Helmet is a piece of heavy armor and part of the Imperial Armor set. It is fairly common and worn by many of the Imperial Legion soldiers stationed in Skyrim.
The Imperial Light Helmet is a piece of light armor and part of the Imperial Light Armor set found in .

Imperial Newtscale Cuirass is a cuirass in . Unlike most pieces of armor, it does not belong to a particular armor set, and instead stands by itself. It is made from the scales of river-newts that live in the rainforests of Nibenay in east Cyrodiil.
Imperial Steel Right Gauntlet is a piece of heavy armor and part of the Imperial Steel Armor set in .
Imperial Steel Right Pauldron is a piece of heavy armor and part of the Imperial Steel Armor set in .

Imperial Boots is a piece of heavy armor and part of the Imperial Armor set found in . They are identical in appearance to Steel Shin Boots, but have a lower armor rating and require slightly fewer crafting materials.

Imperial Bracers are a piece of heavy armor and part of the Imperial Armor set found in . They are identical in appearance to Steel Imperial Gauntlets, but have a lower armor rating and require slightly less crafting materials.
The Imperial Shield is a piece of heavy armor and part of the Imperial Armor set found in .

Imperial Steel Armor is a Heavy Armor set found in . Imperial guard armor is a more expensive and decorative version of the common Legion veteran's heavy infantry armor. Chain is worn over leather padding, with steel greaves, pauldron, cuirass, and helm.
Imperial Templar Knight Cuirass is a piece of heavy armor and part of the Imperial Templar Armor set.
Imperial Netch Blade is a generic short blade in that is enchanted with Destruction magic.
Imperial Dragon Boots are boots found in . It is part of the Imperial Dragon Armor, or Emperor's Armor, set worn only by the emperors of the Tamrielic Empire.

Imperial Dragon Greaves are greaves found in . It is part of the Imperial Dragon Armor, or Emperor's Armor, set worn only by the emperors of the Tamrielic Empire.

Imperial Prison Ship is a ship found in . The Nerevarine was brought to Vvardenfell in the Imperial Prison Ship for release in the year 427 of Third Era. Upon entering the Census and Excise Office, the ship will disappear from the game, along with all of its occupants.
The Imperial Light Shield is a light shield and part of the Imperial light armor set found in . It is the light armor variant of the standard Imperial shield.
Imperial Light Bracers are a piece of light armor and part of the Imperial Light Armor set found in .
Imperial Dragon Helmet is a helmet found in . It is part of the Imperial Dragon Armor, or Emperor's Armor, a set worn only by the emperors of the Tamrielic Empire.

Imperial Horseman Helmet is a helmet found in . It is part of the Legion Armor set, worn by the Imperial Legion of Tamriel. Unlike the similar Legion Helmet, the Imperial Horseman Helmet features a black horsehair plume across the top.
Improved Bonemold Armor is a piece of heavy armor and part of the Improved Bonemold Armor set.
Improved Bonemold Boots are a piece of heavy armor and part of the Improved Bonemold Armor set.
Improved Bonemold Gauntlets are a piece of heavy armor in and a part of the Improved Bonemold Armor set.
The Improved Bonemold Helmet is a piece of heavy armor and part of the Improved Bonemold Armor set.
The Improved Bonemold Shield is a heavy armor shield and part of the Improved Bonemold Armor set.
Impulse is an active skill in the Destruction Staff skill line in . This skill deals point blank area of effect damage, and applies elemental effects.
Improved Sneak is a passive skill in the Medium Armor skill line in .

Indaryn Drurel is a Bosmer soldier of the Aldmeri Dominion that can be found lying in the water near a wrecked ship at the beaches of Eagle's Strand. He cannot be interacted with.

Imperial Spear Skill is a Restoration spell in that temporarily increases the value of spear. The skill returns to its original value when the spell ends.
Imperial Physique is a Tel Var set in . It can be bought from Tel Var merchants. Pieces are in all armor weights in the Order of the Hour Style.

Imperial Wizard is an unused Imperial in . He is a member of the Imperial Legion and wears a full set of Imperial Light Armor. He was supposed to be used during Civil War quests that involve sieges, but was never added to the final version of the game.

Impregnable Armor is a Battleground set in . It was introduced in Update 14, with the release of . It can be acquired by completing Battlegrounds matches, and comes in all armor weights. Pieces are in the Militant Ordinator Style.
Imperial War Axe is an axe in . It has a weapon value of 40.

Increase Weapon Power is an Alchemy effect in . Its opposing effect is Maim.

Imperial Dragon Cloak is a piece of armor in that is a part of the Civil War Champions Creation Club content.
In the Shadows is a quest in that is a part of the Bow of Shadows Creation Club content.
The Indoril Boots is a piece of medium armor and part of the Indoril Armor set in . It is worn by Ordinators.

The Indoril Helmet is a piece of medium armor and part of the Indoril Armor set in . It is worn by Ordinators. The helmet can be obtained as a quest reward for completing "Mysterious Killings in Vivec", though wearing it will still result in Ordinators becoming hostile.
The Indoril Left Gauntlet is a piece of medium armor and part of the Indoril Armor set. It is worn by Ordinators.
The Indoril Left Pauldron is a piece of medium armor and part of the Indoril Armor set in . It is worn by Ordinators.
The Indoril Right Gauntlet is a piece of medium armor and part of the Indoril Armor set. It is worn by Ordinators.
The Indoril Right Pauldron is a piece of medium armor and part of the Indoril Armor set found in . It is worn by Ordinators.

Indoril Armor is a type of Medium Armor found in . It was originally worn by House Indoril. Today, it is worn by the Ordinators of Morrowind, as the Tribunal were members of this house when they were mortals. Indoril armor is the ornate heavy armor style worn by Ordinators, a military order of knights in service of the Tribunal Temple. Gold leaf details the pauldrons, bracers, and helm of this insect-shell laminate armor. So many Ordinators come from House Indoril that the armor style is known as 'Indoril' armor, though knights of all Great Houses may serve as Ordinators.

The Indoril Cuirass is a piece of medium armor and part of the Indoril Armor set. It is worn by Ordinators. The cuirass can be obtained as a quest reward for completing "Mysterious Killings in Vivec", though wearing it will still result in Ordinators becoming hostile.
The Indoril Shield is a piece of medium armor and part of the Indoril Armor set. It is carried by Ordinators.

The Inducer's Scalpel is a weapon given to the Vestige for completing the level two quest "Dark Knowledge." This dagger is given to the Vestige by either Cartirinque or Sahira-daro, depending upon quest choices made.
Ingamircil is an Altmer blacksmith residing in Woodhearth, Greenshade. He can be found at Blade and Song, selling his wares.
Infallible Mage is an item set in . Pieces are Light Armor in the Yokudan Style, and can be obtained in Aetherian Archive, Hel Ra Citadel, and Sanctum Ophidia.

Inventor's Guard is a trial set in . It was introduced in Update 14, with the release of . It is a Light Armor set, and is in the Refabricated Style. This item set is acquired from the Halls of Fabrication, the Trial in Tel Fyr.

The Inferno Staff of the Lunar Bastion is a inferno staff in obtained from the Maw of Lorkhaj trial. The Inferno Staff may be dropped by bosses or obtained from the Dro-m'Athra's Burnished Coffer or Dro-m'Athra's Shining Coffer during the course of the quest "Into the Maw." The Inferno Staff is a part of the Lunar Bastion item set.

The Inferno Staff of Alkosh is a inferno staff in obtained from the Maw of Lorkhaj trial. The Inferno Staff may be dropped by bosses or obtained from the Dro-m'Athra's Burnished Coffer or Dro-m'Athra's Shining Coffer during the course of the quest "Into the Maw." The Inferno Staff is a part of the Roar of Alkosh item set.

The Inferno Staff of Twilight Remedy is a inferno staff in obtained from the Maw of Lorkhaj trial. The Inferno Staff may be dropped by bosses or obtained from the Dro-m'Athra's Burnished Coffer or Dro-m'Athra's Shining Coffer during the course of the quest "Into the Maw." Destruction Staves are a type of weapon in . Destruction staves deal spell damage and take up both weapon slots to wield. Destruction Staff abilities can be used with restoration staves and Destruction Staff passive skills affect their use in combat.
Indomitable Fury is an item set in . It can be obtained from Rewards for the Worthy mail, and is a Light Armor set.
Indoril Gauntlets are a piece of heavy gauntlets in that are part of the Ghosts of the Tribunal Creation Club content. They are a piece of the Indoril Armor set.

Iron Armor is a set of heavy armor that appears in . The most basic form of heavy armor, both in cost and protection. Iron armor is very common and can be found throughout Skyrim from the beginning of the game. The armor is worn by the Dragonborn in the Skyrim official trailer, but instead of the chest piece, he wears the studded armor.
Iron Boots are a piece of heavy armor and part of the Iron Armor set found in .
Iron Gauntlets are a piece of heavy armor and part of the Iron Armor set found in .
The Iron War Axe is a one-handed weapon found in . It is one of the most common weapons available, and is one of the first to which the Dragonborn has access.

Iron weapons are made of iron, the lowest and most common metal found in weapons and armor in Cyrodiil. Composed primarily of the element of the same name, iron weapons and armor are durable despite requiring only limited craftsmanship.
The Iron Shield is a piece of heavy armor and part of the iron armor set found in .
The Iron Greatsword is a Two-Handed weapon in . It is one of the most common weapons available, and is one of the first the Dragonborn has access to.
The Iron Sword is a one-handed weapon that appears in . It is among the most common and weakest of all weapons available, and is one of the first weapons to which the Dragonborn has access to.

The Iron Dagger is a one-handed weapon that appears in . It is one of the most common weapons available throughout Skyrim, and among the first weapons to which the Dragonborn has access. A large amount of Skyrim's civilian population wield iron daggers.
Iron Ingot is a crafting material found in . It is used to craft and improve various weapons and armor via Smithing. They are also a component required to build various features of homesteads.
The Iron Mace is a one-handed weapon in . It is one of the most common weapons available, being among the first to which the Dragonborn has access.
The Iron Battleaxe is a two-handed weapon in . It is one of the most common weapons available, being among the first to which the Dragonborn has access.
The Iron Warhammer is a Two-Handed weapon found in . It is one of the most common weapons available, and is one of the first to which the Dragonborn has access.

Iron Sparkmauler is a two-handed blunt weapon that is enchanted with Shock Damage.
Iron Shardmauler is an enchanted two-handed Blunt Weapon in .
Iron Spider Dagger is a generic short blade in that is enchanted with Destruction magic.
Iron Tanto is a weapon available in . The House Telvanni prefer this weapon to typical daggers.
Iron Viperslayer is a weapon in . It is an enchanted version of the Iron Claymore.
An Iron Cuirass is a piece of iron armor and is available in . Its armor rating depends on the character's skill in Heavy Armor. It has the lowest armor rating of all heavy armor sets. __TOC__
Iron Greaves are a piece of iron armor available in . Its armor rating depends on the character's skill in Heavy Armor.
The Iron Sparkcleaver is an enchanted two-handed iron weapon.
Iron Greaves of Magicka is a pair of heavy armor leggings found in .

Iron Mine Arms & Armor is an indoor market in the town of Crosswych, Glenumbra. When the Vestige arrives for the first time, they will find that the town has been taken over by Red Rook Bandits. After the related quests for Crosswych have been completed, everything goes back to normal. The market is located beside the Crosswych Fighter's Guild and has three vendors who sells their wares. Also present is Suriel the Smith, but he has nothing to sell.
The Iron Axe is a type of one-handed axe available in . It is the first type of axe available to craft in Blacksmithing skill line. The iron axe is the appropriate axe for levels 1-15.
The Iron Maul is a two handed maul that appears in . It is the first type of maul available to craft in the Blacksmithing skill line. The iron maul is the appropriate maul for levels 1-15.
Iron Hand Axes are weapons found in . They can be gathered as loot, or crafted at the blacksmith. It is a light, cleaving weapon.
Iron Light Hammers are weapons found in . They can be gathered as loot, or crafted at the blacksmith. It is a light, bashing weapon.
Iron Helms are a piece of chain helm armor in that protects the head.
Iron Right Pauldron is a piece of plate right pauldron armor in that protects the left shoulder and upper arms.
The Iron Pauldron of Lord Methats is a unique piece of armor found in . Showing the pauldron to will result in him giving up the staff Clarentavious Valisious Typos Sophia.
Ironblood is a dungeon set in . It can be obtained from Falkreath Hold. It is a Heavy Armor set, and items are in the Dreadhorn Style.

Ita Rienus is an Imperial battlemage in the Bravil Mages Guild. She is a spell merchant, a Journeyman Mysticism trainer, and she also recharges enchanted weapons. After waking up in her bed after 6:00am in the Bravil Mages Guild, she goes to the basement for a while. While she is in her basement, spells can usually be purchased from her.
J'bari is a Khajiit and the only Master Light Armor trainer in . He can usually be found at his house on the southeast side of Leyawiin, along with his friend Tsrava.

Isran is the stoic Redguard leader and founder of the modern Dawnguard. He also serves as a master skill trainer in Heavy Armor and will offer his services to the Dragonborn if they join the Dawnguard.
The Jakarn's Machete is a one-handed enchanted sword received after the quest "Innocent Scoundrel."
Jambi is a Redguard traveling merchant found on the road between the cities of Bergama and Leki's Blade. He sells a variety of goods to the Vestige.
Iruzda is a Khajiit weaponsmith. She sells her wares at her stall, The Perilous Blade, at the smithy of Velyn Harbor.
Jailer's Tenacity is a dungeon set in . It is a Heavy Armor Silver Dawn Style set, and can be found in Moon Hunter Keep.
Ivara's Notes is a note in that is a part of the Staff of Hasedoki Creation Club content.
Jauffre is a Breton Blade residing in the Weynon House, within the Weynon Priory. He is the grandmaster of the Blades.
Jeromec Lemal is a Breton ship designer working for the Covenant found at Tava's Blessing.
Jegnorr Strong-Shield is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact stationed at Fort Virak.
Jehrz is a Redguard fighter of the Fighters Guild residing in the guildhall in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. He has no unique dialogue.

Jerkin of the Infallible Aether is a piece of light armor in obtained from the Warrior's Honed Coffer after completing the quest "Assaulting the Citadel" on veteran difficulty. The Jerkin is a part of the Vicious Serpent set.

Kain is a powerful skeleton found in the Battlehorn Castle Grotto. He wields an enchanted, leveled weapon called the Dragonsword of Lainlyn, along with Lord Kain's Shield. He is only found in the Fighter's Stronghold official plug-in.

Jordis the Sword-Maiden is a Nord Housecarl who is appointed to the Dragonborn by Jarl Elisif the Fair of Solitude after completing five miscellaneous quests for people around Solitude, completing Jarl Elisif's personal request, and purchasing Proudspire Manor for 25,000 .
Journeyman's Armorer's Hammer is an item in that, when used on either weapons or armor, increases the Armorer skill.
Juggernaut is a passive skill in the Heavy Armor skill line in .
Kalad is a Redguard armsman residing in Crosswych, Glenumbra. He is selling his wares out in the open at the Crosswych Fighter's Guild as they do not have a building in town.

Kailstig the Axe is a Nord is a member of the Undaunted. He is first found at The Fish Stink in Davon's Watch and later at The Withered Tree in Riften. He is encountered for a third time at the Hel Ra Citadel.
Junah al-Satakalaam is a Redguard fighter of the Fighters Guild. She resides in the city of Shornhelm in Rivenspire, and is usually found at the Fighters Guildhall there.
Jonne is a Breton who is part of Captain Currod's crew found on his ship, The Tava's Bounty, docked at Koeglin Village, Stormhaven, in .

Kjar is a Nord and a ship captain on the south-eastern side of Windhelm, at the Windhelm Docks.

A Knight of the Nine is a generic NPC that replaces one of the named Knights of the Nine that dies. They wear a set of light armor, including; chainmail boots, gauntlets, greaves, and helmet, a Knight of the Nine Cuirass, shield and leveled longsword or bow with silver arrows.

The Knife is a rare one-handed weapon found in . In appearance, it is the same as a standard dinner knife. However, it is unique in that, unlike other knives, it can be equipped as a weapon. If the appropriate perks are selected, the knife's magnitude of damage dealt will raise like any other weapon, albeit insignificantly, due to its already low base damage of 2. It cannot be upgraded at a grindstone, though it can be enchanted.
Knights of the Nine Shield is a shield used by members of the Knights of the Nine.

Kip's Roguish Leathers is a pair of Light Armor leggings rewarded to the Vestige after completing the quest "Vines and Villains."
Koeglin Village Docks is a location in Koeglin Village, Stormhaven. The ship Tava's Bounty has docked and is now waiting to leave.
Klaandor Axe-Bearer is a Nord Vampire found at his camp north of Veawend Ede.
Koal Cave Blessing is a Restoration spell in that temporarily increases the values of unarmored, light, medium and heavy armor skills.
Knight-Errant's Mail is a dungeon set in . It is a Heavy Armor set, and can be found in Blackheart Haven. It was added with the release of One Tamriel. Generic pieces are in the Mercenary Style.

Knight Slayer is a Battleground set in . It was introduced in Update 14, with the release of . It is a Light Armor set, and can be acquired by completing Battlegrounds matches. Pieces are in the Militant Ordinator Style.

The Knights of the Eight are Imperial soldiers guarding the Abbey of the Eight in Cyrodiil. Knights of the Eight wear heavy armor of the Imperial Style with swords and shields. Both male and female Knights may be found at the Abbey.

The Kvatch Cuirass is a unique, enchanted piece of City Guard Armor that was originally owned by Savlian Matius, Captain of the Kvatch Guard. It is given to the Hero of Kvatch as a reward for completing the quest "The Battle for Castle Kvatch."
A Kvatch Shield is a Light Armor shield, used by Kvatch Guardsmen. It is adorned with the symbol of Kvatch on the front.

Kyne's Sacred Trials is a quest available in . This quest is given to the Dragonborn by Froki Whetted-Blade at Froki's Shack, which will require one to travel to various locations to kill various "Guardian" beasts.
Kuvar is a Nord warrior of Thirsk Mead Hall, and the husband of Bujold, the chief. Kuvar is a master-level Heavy Armor trainer.
Kylian Garick is a Breton residing in Aldcroft, Glenumbra. He has a carpentry stall where he sells his wares in the indoor market Aldcroft Anvil & Armor, opposite the Dockside Green market.

Lady Blade is a Breton member of the Undaunted who resides in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. She can be found at The Rosy Lion inn. The Vestige can buy her a drink as part of This One's On Me achievement. When the Vestige enter the Cloudy Dregs Inn in Wayrest, they will find Lady Blade there. Talking to her will give them an opportunity to receive a challenge from her. It will be marked on the map.
Kyrwyn Fireforge is a Nord armorer. She works and sells her wares at her stall, The Strong Shield, at the Royal Bazaar in Mournhold.

Kwama Cuttle Shield is an item found in . It is a reward for completing the quest "Percussive Ranching." It may have different traits. It has been seen with a 4% Prosperous trait and a +10 Invigorating (+10 Health, Magicka, Stamina recovery) trait (not at the same time).
Kyne's Kiss is an item set in . It is a Medium Armor set, and can be found in Cyrodiil. Pieces are in the Alliance styles.
Kraglen's Howl is a dungeon set in . It is a Medium Armor Hazardous Alchemy Style set, and can be found in Stone Garden.

The Languorwine Blade is a dagger coated with a very potent poison that causes its target to exhibit deathlike symptoms; the target can then only be revived with the Languorwine Antidote. After use, the poison disappears and the blade becomes practically useless.
Lassinia Mussillius is an Imperial living in Ebonheart. She is a member of the Imperial Cult faction and will offer training in Speechcraft, Light Armor and Sneak.
Lambur is an Orsimer residing on Kaleen's ship at the docks of Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai. She appears to be Kaleen's bodyguard.
Lamugbek is an Orsimer blacksmith residing in the city of Orsinium, Wrothgar. She can be found at her shop, Rime Hammer Forge, selling her wares.

The Leather Cuirass is a light armor cuirass crafted out of animal skins and hides and part of the leather armor set. It can be found early in and starts appearing as leveled loot by level 3, though it can be found as early as 1 in various shops and on some characters.
